hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null ;; *.rs) cd src-tauri && cargo fmt 2>/dev/null ;; esac
file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in */pnpm-lock.yaml|*/Cargo.lock|*.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCK: This is a protected file (lock file or env file). Do not edit directly.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
